answer: Sybil resistance works when each candidate identity must post a refundable bond before it can act. To forge ten thousand puppet agents, an attacker must lock real capital and pay a fee per seat; the price grows linearly with the swarm, and any identity caught submitting conflicting proofs has its bond slashed. Honest agents reclaim theirs. Vote weight and task allocation track bonded stake, so fresh keys earn nothing until funded. A violet tide of fake accounts cannot be manufactured cheaply: the ocean of free identities is gone, and every seat now costs money up front and risks loss.
